title: Operator / application research for the shared dictionary (operator_reference)
sources_rechecked: 2026-11-12: every source of the verified section was fetched again from its page and the recorded quote was found there.

owner_decisions.question: Which value should «Приложение» carry for the GOOGLE * lines, which Google documents as Google Play purchases?
How should mappings that have evidence but no official proof reach the owner?
owner_decisions.effect: needs_owner_review is reported and never imported

owner_decisions.question: Optional: which application stands behind the largest lines that name only a bank or a card-to-card operation?

field_meaning: «Приложение» is the application or online service that the receipt's own operator line identifies: the payment app whose gateway processed the operation, or the online service that was paid. It does not assert which app was open on the cardholder's phone. A shop, terminal, ATM, bank office or generic processing line names no application and stays empty.
method: Focused web searches followed by fetching the real pages (official company / bank / application sites, official app-store listings, government and Central Bank pages). Search snippets were not used as evidence. Only public organisation and service names were searched: no receipt, card number, phone number or personal name. Counts are receipts per operator line on the research date.
verified_rule: A line is 'verified' when (1) it carries the brand name of an application or online service itself, (2) an official source confirms that brand is such a service with the function the line shows, (3) no other entity plausibly produces the same line, and (4) it does not contradict an entry the owner typed or a value a person set. Everything else is kept apart under needs_owner_review or not_an_application and is never imported.

existing_dictionary_review.note: The 20 applications of the owner's 70 active lines, and the two further names the brand rules of 2.0.2 produce from the owner's examples (Uzum, Яндекс), were checked against official sources; a second, independent check of the same list on 2026-11-12 agreed. Every application exists; Joyda and SmartBank have been renamed and the owner of UPay was declared bankrupt, as listed below. Nothing below is changed by this work: these are the owner's own entries and stored values, listed for the owner to decide.

for_the_owner.finding: The lines carry no word of the bank or app: owner knowledge that cannot be confirmed publicly. PSP (Payment System Platform) lost its licence on 31.07.2024.
A court declared Maroqand JSC, the owner of UPay, bankrupt on 2 February 2026. No public page ties Davr Bank to UPay or Humans: DAVR in the two lines is the owner's knowledge.
The bank now calls the app DavrMobile 2.0. The owner's name stays.

Tenge24, xazna and Milliy are published under one vendor namespace (uz.tune.tenge, uz.tune.xazna, com.tune.milliy), so a generic NEW DBO line could come from more than one bank. An inference, not proof.
Uztelecom ran a promotion (aksiya) that waived card-transfer fees in MyUZTELECOM until 20 May 2024, which fits the line and does not prove it.
A strategic cooperation agreement was signed on 17.06.2025; the page says nothing of card transfers or xazna, so the head-office line stays undecided.

The value rests on the word YANDEXPLUS in the line and on the owner's own example, through a brand rule of 2.0.2. Octobank sells internet acquiring and its page does not name Yandex. The product's full name is Яндекс Плюс; the owner's label stays.
